Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:176306
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 41339 of 2024
Applicant :- Malti Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Gupta
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant, is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Manish Gupta, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Vijay Kumar, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
134 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Sahjanwa,
District Gorakhpur, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother in law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present case alongwith other family members including her son i.e. husband of the deceased.
5.

He further submitted that actually deceased did not want to live in the village and she wanted to live separately from the applicant and she always pressurized her husband i.e. son of the applicant Malti Devi vs State Of U.P. on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35038558/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: to leave the applicant i.e. his mother but when her husband did not accept her proposal then she committed suicide by consuming some insecticide.
6. He further submitted that viscera report of the deceased also suggests that she died due to consumption of insecticide.

He further submitted that viscera report has been annexed alongwith the supplementary affidavit dated 10.11.2024.
7.
He further submitted that there is no specific allegation against the applicant.

8. He further submitted that however, in the FIR there is allegation that earlier also with regard to the dispute arose between applicant side and informant side with regard to the demand of dowry, a panchayat was held and about six months before, daughter of the informant informed him that due to the torture, she made a complaint at police help line No. 112 and after the complaint, police arrived but in this regard during investigation, no evidence could be collected by the Investigating Officer and there is no evidence on record till date which can suggest that earlier also any panchayat was held and police arrived after the complaint made by the deceased as alleged in the FIR.
9.
He further submitted that applicant is lady and and she is having no criminal history and she is in jail in the present matter since 10.6.2024.

10. Per contra, learned AGA, however, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother in law of the deceased and deceased died due to consumption of insecticide and there is no specific allegation against the applicant.
11.
He further, he could not dispute the fact that there is no specific demand of dowry either in the FIR or in the statement of the informant recorded during investigation.
12. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

13. However, from the record, it reflects that deceased died within three years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is allegation of demand of dowry and torture but neither in the FIR nor in the statement recorded during investigation, informant disclosed any specific demand of dowry.
14. Further, applicant is mother in law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.
15. Further as per viscera report, deceased died due to consumption of insecticide, therefore, at this stage, it cannot be said it is not a case of suicidal death.

16. Further, however, in the FIR there is specific allegation that earlier also due to the torture of the applicant and her family members, a panchayat was held and about six months before deceased informed the police about her torture but except the bald and verbal allegation made in the FIR

,
there is no material available on record to substantiate this allegation and Investigating Officer during investigation could not collect any evidence in this regard.

sentences.text:
Further, applicant is lady and she is having no criminal history and she is in jail in the present matter since 10.6.2024.
18.
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances, discussed above, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
19. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

20. Let the applicant-Malti Devi, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
21. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

22. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 11.11.2024 Ankita  Malti Devi vs State Of U.P. on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35038558/
